new_deals_for_notify.author: Unknown
new_deals_for_notify.content_preview:
In short: When we make a new Google account (aka Gmail) then Google used to allot 15GB free space to store mails, photos, drive, documents, files, etc. Now they've reduced it to just 5GB of total free storage.

Something like 10 or 15 years ago (or more) there was an era when we used to get happy of every-increasing storage on Gmail. Gone are those days long ago. Then came 15GB limit and now for new accounts its just 5GB. - well that's quite tiny. 15 GB was decent.
